headline: ACME Solar commissions 50.01 MW solar capacity
summary: ACME Solar Holdings commissioned an additional 50.01 MW of solar capacity at its Bikaner Hybrid Power Project on November 26, 2026, bringing cumulative solar output to 250.05 MW.

headline: Trom Industries wins Rs 10.11 Cr solar order from AMC
summary: Trom Industries secured a Rs 10.11 Cr work order from Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation for 2.5 MWp solar systems. This significant inflow contrasts with Q1FY27's Rs 1.71 Cr, signaling potential revenue acceleration despite low current TTM revenue visibility.

headline: Global Pet Industries wins Rs 3.2 crore order from Omniflux
summary: Global Pet Industries secured a Rs 3.2 crore work order for PET manufacturing lines. This follows a Rs 15.04 crore inflow in Q3FY27. Book-to-bill context remains critical given recent revenue trends.

headline: Abs Marine wins Rs 120.14 Cr order from ONGC
summary: Abs Marine Services secures a Rs 120.14 crore charter hire order from ONGC for PSV Emerald. This adds to recent inflows, with total disclosed backlog at Rs 311.16 Cr against FY26 revenue of Rs 322.60 Cr.

headline: Urban Enviro wins Rs 2.22 Cr waste order from Nagar Panchayat Aheri
summary: Urban Enviro Waste Management secured a Rs 2.22 crore work order for waste processing in Maharashtra. This adds to its recent inflows, with Q1FY27 seeing Rs 39.82 crore in orders.

headline: Adisoft wins Rs 12.56 Cr order for Industry 4.0 solutions
summary: Adisoft Technologies secured a Rs 12.56 crore commercial order from a domestic private entity. The deal covers automated assembly and robotic cells, extending backlog visibility through March 2027.

headline: Rachana Infra wins Rs 147 Cr road order from Ahmedabad R&B
summary: Rachana Infrastructure secured a Rs 146.98 crore work order for road widening in Gujarat. The deal, awarded by Ahmedabad (R&B) Division, adds to a Rs 295.71 crore Q3 inflow, significantly boosting the company's backlog relative to its recent revenue base.

headline: Swaraj Suiting gets in-principle approval for preferential issue
summary: Swaraj Suiting Ltd received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for a preferential issue of 35 lakh equity shares and 17 lakh warrants at ₹335 each.

headline: Omnitech Engineering wins development order from BrahMos
summary: Omnitech Engineering has received a development order from BrahMos Aerospace for assemblies and sub-assemblies of metallic airframe components and canister subsystems.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Texmaco, Ashiana, EMS in focus
summary: Texmaco rallies 4.86% on new wagon orders, while Ashiana Housing gains 3.18% after a ₹1,100 crore land acquisition. EMS and Walchandnagar also draw attention with fresh contracts.

headline: Biocon secures Brazil approval for Pertuzumab biosimilar
summary: Biocon announced ANVISA approval for Hertuzo, a biosimilar Pertuzumab, in Brazil. The move supports a 10-year partnership with Bionovis to supply HER2-positive breast cancer treatment.

headline: Indian rupee opens at 84.52 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 92.52 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 92.4450, reflecting a marginal depreciation in the domestic currency.

headline: India 10-year bond yield rises to 7.2575%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield rose to 7.2575% from the previous close of 7.2365%, reflecting an uptick in yields in the latest session.

headline: Bernstein maintains Outperform on GSK India, target ₹3430
summary: Bernstein maintained an Outperform rating on GSK India with a target price of ₹3430. GSK India launched Blenrep, its third oncology drug in 15 months and first in blood cancers.

headline: HSBC maintains Reduce on JSW Infrastructure, target ₹280
summary: HSBC maintains a Reduce rating on JSW Infrastructure with a target price of ₹280, citing FY28 execution progress and Jatadhar growth visibility, while flagging utilisation and capital return concerns.

headline: Bernstein sees Zydus correction as buy
summary: Bernstein maintains Outperform on Zydus Lifesciences, viewing the CRL-related stock dip as a buying opportunity. The firm expects a March-April 2027 launch for saroglitazar.

headline: Kings Infra signs ₹311 Cr MoU with TN Govt
summary: Kings Infra Ventures Ltd signed a ₹311 crore MoU with the Tamil Nadu government for an integrated aquaculture and food processing project in Thoothukudi district.

headline: Dr Lal PathLabs sees margin boost from CGHS hike
summary: Dr Lal PathLabs expects 2-3% revenue growth from CGHS price increase, boosting margins. Benefits slow from Q3. FY27 revenue forecast held at mid-to-high teens.

headline: Karamtara Engineering targets 60-65% growth in FY27
summary: Karamtara Engineering expects 60-65% growth for FY27, signalling strong business momentum in the engineering sector.

headline: Zen Technologies expects stronger H2 performance
summary: Zen Technologies anticipates a stronger performance in the second half of the fiscal year compared to the first half, signalling improved business momentum ahead.

headline: Aarvi Encon investor presentation highlights
summary: Aarvi Encon reports FY26 revenue of ₹6,499 million with EBITDA margins at 3.49%. The company maintains a low gearing ratio of 0.10x and reaffirms CRISIL BBB/Stable ratings.

headline: Karamtara Engineering plans ₹400 crore Saudi plant
summary: Karamtara Engineering is investing ₹400 crore in Phase-1 of a plant in Saudi Arabia, targeting revenue of ₹1,800-2,000 crore by FY29.

headline: Mahanadi Coalfields lists below issue price at NSE
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields began trading at ₹134 per share on NSE, falling below its issue price of ₹136 per share, marking a subdued market debut.

headline: Netweb Technologies launches Skylus Workspace platform
summary: Netweb Technologies India Limited launched Skylus Workspace, an enterprise digital workspace platform, on November 27, 2026. The product currently targets the Indian market.

headline: Siemens Energy India approves FY26 audited results
summary: Siemens Energy India Limited's board approved audited financial results for FY26 on November 25, 2026. The filing confirms statutory audit by Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP.

headline: Religare promoter group converts warrants
summary: Religare Enterprises promoter group entities converted 1.27 crore warrants into equity shares, increasing their total holding to 32.89% of diluted capital.

headline: Avalon Technologies shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,48,292 Avalon Technologies shares on BSE at ₹1,880.50 per share, with a combined value of ₹46.69 crore.

headline: JPL shares worth ₹49.48 crore change hands in large trade
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 358,762 JPL shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,379.10 per share, for a combined value of ₹49.48 crore.

headline: Gennex Labs promoter sells 1.47% stake
summary: Premier Fiscal Services sold 35.72 lakh Gennex Laboratories shares on BSE for ₹3.23 crore, reducing promoter holding to 20.36%.

headline: Paos Industries promoter group reshuffles 7.37% stake
summary: Paos Industries discloses inter-se transfer of shares from Rama Bansal to Megha Kansal. Promoter group holding remains unchanged at 74.71%.

headline: Karan Singh Thakral raises stake in DCM Ltd
summary: Karan Singh Thakral acquired 28,655 shares of DCM Ltd in open market, lifting combined holding with PACs to 7.03%.

headline: Siemens Energy confident on VSC-HVDC order in India
summary: Siemens Energy has expressed confidence in securing an upcoming VSC-HVDC order in India next year, signalling strong intent in the country's high-voltage transmission segment.

headline: NCL Industries promoter group acquires shares
summary: Kakatiya Industries and NCL Holdings acquired 31,252 shares in NCL Industries via open market on Nov 25, 2026, raising combined promoter group stake to 3.001%.

headline: Dhruv Consultancy promoter buys 102 shares
summary: Pandurang B. Dandawate acquired 102 equity shares of Dhruv Consultancy Services Ltd via open market on November 18, 2026. His holding remains at 21.31%.

headline: HPPL Petrofer acquires 1 share in Hardcastle
summary: HPPL Petrofer LLP, a member of the promoter group, acquired one equity share of Hardcastle & Waud Manufacturing Company Limited via open market on November 26, 2026.

headline: Deutsche Bank releases 10.4% Piramal Pharma stake
summary: Deutsche Bank AG released a pledge on 13.84 crore shares of Piramal Pharma, representing 10.40% of the company's share capital, following a permitted sale transaction by the borrower.

headline: Shyam Metalics subsidiary boosts Ramsarup stake to 98%
summary: Shyam Sel and Power Limited acquired additional equity in Ramsarup Industries, raising the parent's aggregate holding to 98.06% via a ₹98 crore preferential allotment.

headline: Smallcap World Fund cuts APL Apollo stake to 3%
summary: SMALLCAP World Fund, Inc. reduced its holding in APL Apollo Tubes Ltd. by 2.04% through open market sales on November 25, 2026.

headline: Kothari Industrial signs MoUs for drone training
summary: Kothari Industrial Corporation Ltd signs two MoUs with Thiagarajar College of Engineering to launch a Remote Pilot Training Organization and UAV R&D center in Madurai.

headline: Kuberan Global Edu: Menezes family stake rises to 5.13%
summary: Bosco Armando and Emily Bosco Menezes acquired 6,000 shares in open market. Combined holding in Kuberan Global Edu Solutions Ltd increased from 4.84% to 5.13%.

headline: Natural Biocon AGM to adopt FY26 loss, appoint four directors
summary: Natural Biocon (India) Ltd schedules its 34th AGM for Dec 14, 2026, to adopt FY26 financials showing a net loss of ₹4 lakh and appoint four independent directors.

headline: Transpek Q2FY27 PAT up 63% to ₹20.6 crore
summary: Transpek Industry reported a 62.7% YoY rise in Q2FY27 PAT to ₹20.6 crore, driven by 23% revenue growth. The company also approved a ₹41 crore land acquisition in Odisha.

headline: Kilaru Dileep acquires 0.20% stake in Haleos Labs
summary: Kilaru Dileep, immediate relative of a designated person, acquired 6,000 equity shares of Haleos Labs in open market transactions on November 23, 2026.

headline: Shree Siddhivinayak IPO Subscribed 1.52x
summary: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO closed at 1.52x overall subscription. QIBs led demand at 4.27x, while Retail interest rose to 1.97x on Day 3.

headline: Foodlink IPO Day 2: Subscribed 1.28x
summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO sees retail demand surge to 3.18x on Day 2, lifting overall subscription to 1.28x. QIB interest remains steady at 1.01x.

headline: Varigate sells 10,000 shares in Arman Holdings
summary: Varigate Advisory Services disposed of 10,000 equity shares in Arman Holdings via open market sale on November 25, 2026. Post-transaction holding stands at 4.86%.

headline: Arman Financial allots ₹47.50 crore NCDs
summary: Arman Financial Services allotted 4,750 senior secured NCDs worth ₹47.50 crore on private placement. The six-year debentures carry a fixed coupon of 10.75% per annum.

headline: Eco Hotels board approves major leadership overhaul
summary: Eco Hotels and Resorts Limited's board accepted four director resignations and appointed Amandeep Singh Kakar as Chairman & Whole-Time Director on November 27, 2026.

headline: Divgi TorqTransfer to host investor meet Dec 9
summary: Divgi TorqTransfer Systems will attend an investor conference in Mumbai on December 9, 2026. The meeting, organized by Centrum Broking, focuses on public business updates.

headline: Vinati Organics to host HDFC MF meeting Dec 2
summary: Vinati Organics Limited will hold a one-on-one meeting with HDFC Mutual Fund on December 2, 2026. The session is scheduled for 3:30 pm at the Mumbai corporate office.
